scope: Nine individually reviewed SFV4-arbitrary-tests advisories; no other exception or property-coverage claim

entries.reason: Deterministic native SQLite lifecycle regressions exercise retirement, bounded recovery, corruption refusal, disposition accounting and atomic failure boundaries. Codecs encode fixed synthetic inputs and decode SQL evidence; generated round trips would not test transaction or recovery ordering. Exit: reusable schema laws move here or an independently modeled randomized lifecycle invariant is introduced. Independent Astra review: intentional deterministic integration/regression coverage; no unverified property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Real-socket regressions qualify exact JSON/protobuf acknowledgments, gzip/streaming limits, malformed input, concurrent admission, commit failure and expired-event rejection. Codecs construct controlled wire fixtures and inspect receipt identity. Exit: reusable codec laws move here; generated transport testing must retain the malformed/incomplete-body and controlled fault cases. Independent Astra review: intentional deterministic integration/regression coverage; no unverified property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Integration fixtures create specific Git repositories/worktrees and declared retired, missing or inaccessible roots to verify pseudonymous identity, attribution and privacy. Codecs serialize declarations and inspect inventory evidence, not schema laws. Exit: pure schema laws move here or are separated; preserve retired-root no-access and private-path assertions. Independent Astra review: intentional deterministic integration/regression coverage; no unverified property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Composed-worker regressions exercise native SQLite, actual listeners, pause/drain ownership, scheduler delivery and private maintenance/backup/retirement. Codecs support exact requests and receipts at controlled lifecycle boundaries. Exit: reusable schema laws move here or a meaningful independent worker reference model is designed; preserve refusal and resource-ordering cases. Independent Astra review: intentional deterministic integration/regression coverage; no unverified property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Deterministic byte-level regressions cover UTF-8/CRLF offsets, incomplete tails, persisted-cursor restart, truncation/replacement, copied occurrences, oversized/malformed lines and privacy. Codecs preserve exact fixture/cursor evidence for bounded incremental reading. Exit: a changed segmentation/identity algorithm motivates an independently designed partition-invariance property. Independent Astra review: intentional deterministic integration/regression coverage; no unverified property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Managed-command integration regressions use fixed synthetic owner/enrollment/grant records, actual child lifecycle and independent private claim/outbox files. They verify offline recording with an absent collector, refusal before spawn, preserved authority and uncertain closure. No schema-law or successful collector-delivery coverage is claimed. Exit: pure model laws move here; retain child, zero-receipt and no-relaunch assertions. Independent Astra review: intentional deterministic integration/regression coverage; no unverified property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Deterministic command/rendering regressions verify expected unit/proxy configuration, journal-derived limits, interpolation/path-overlap refusal, malformed inputs and absence of installation side effects. Deliberate adversarial literals and boundaries are the subject. Exit: a changed escaping/path contract motivates an independently designed rendering property, or reusable schema laws move here. Independent Astra review: intentional deterministic integration/regression coverage; no unverified property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Deterministic regressions serialize fixed policy/submission fixtures across real child processes, kill producers at four exact durability/operation boundaries, and race independent producers for one private file-backed claim. Schema-generated round trips do not establish crash ordering or exclusive claims. Exit: reusable schema laws or an independently modeled claim-state property move here; preserve exact SIGKILL boundaries and the process race. Independently reviewed by Astra; no property coverage elsewhere is claimed.

Real loopback HTTP and SQLite regressions verify committed acknowledgment/replay, private-field and destination/epoch/route refusal, conflicts, streaming limits, incomplete bodies, concurrent admission, disabled enrollment and rollback without acknowledgment. Codecs support controlled failure fixtures and receipts. Exit: reusable codec laws move here or normalization/stream decoding gains an independently specified generated invariant; preserve malformed requests, privacy canary, rollback and timing cases. Independently reviewed by Astra; no property coverage elsewhere is claimed.
